author: bencos18
install_msg: Thank you for installing the BotReport cog. The bot owner can configure it globally with [p]botreportset channel #channel, then members can reply to a message or use a message ID/link with [p]botreport.
description: Allows members in servers and DMs to report messages, including bot-generated memes and images, by reply, message ID, or Discord message link to one bot-owner-configured channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog processes and forwards Discord user IDs, usernames, message content, attachment URLs, and report reasons to the bot owner's configured report channel. It does not persist this data.
